messages:
Leah P.: Quick cross-team check-in for Q2 milestones — dropping current status for each owner below. Please reply with `status / ETA / blockers` inline. We want to surface any handoffs or deps by EOD so product can update the roadmap.
Sam K.: Platform -> autoscaler for model-serving: shipped to staging yesterday, canary traffic running. Status: shipped (staging/canary). Owner: Sam. ETA prod promote: tomorrow AM. Blocker: none atm. :thumbsup:
Mike R.: Runtime -> perf regression after 8-bit path landed. Status: slipped. Owner: Mike. ETA for hotfix: ~48h. Blocker: failing L2 cache alignment test in our microbench.
Mike R.: Logs snippet:
```
[ERROR] kv_cache_align: misaligned pointer at offset 0x48
p95 increased by 35% after quant path
```
Jia L.: Model -> 8-bit variant validated on evals, ready to deploy but blocked by runtime regression. Status: blocked. Owner: Jia. ETA: dependent on runtime fix (~72h if hotfix lands quickly). Blocker: runtime regression + need smoke test signal.
Tanya V.: Infra -> IAM roles change merged; rollout paused while canary stabilizes. Status: partial rollout. Owner: Tanya. ETA: today afternoon for remaining clusters. Blocker: need one sec approval for role escalation.
Omar S.: SRE -> saw tail latency bump on canary after autoscaler tuning. Status: monitoring. Owner: Omar. Action: if p95 > 220ms for 30m we revert. Posting metrics: https://metrics.internal/r/redwood/canary (live)
Leah P.: Action items pinned:
- @Sam K. promote canary -> prod if p95 < 200ms for 30m
- @Mike R. open PR with hotfix and request review from @Omar S. + @Jia L.
- @Tanya V. file sec approval ticket and ping infra-sec
- @Jia L. stand by for deploy tests
If anyone misses ETA, flag here so we can reassign.
Sam K.: Ack. I will promote when stable. Condition: p95 < 200ms for 30m. Will watch dashboard and report back.
Mike R.: Creating PR now: #4123 - "runtime: fix kv_cache alignment in quant path". ETA PR + tests: ~3h. Tagging reviewers @jia @omar.
deploy-bot: Canary promote event: canary -> staging promoted at ts=1772512000 by Sam K.
Omar S.: Watching the promote. Will alert on any regressions and post a rollback cmd if needed:
```
./ops/rollbacks/promote_rollback --cluster canary
```
Tanya V.: Sec approval ticket filed: SEC-4521. Waiting on response from @security. If they greenlight within 2h, infra rollout continues.
Leah P.: Thanks all — if hotfix lands and canary stays green we'll call this done and update the OKR board. Otherwise we'll run a short sync at 4:30pm. :eyes:
Sam K.: Update: after 45m p95=185ms, no errors. Planning prod promote at 10:30AM tomorrow. :rocket:
Mike R.: PR #4123 ready, pushed fix and tests passed locally. Requesting review.
Jia L.: Will queue smoke tests once PR merges. Standby.
Omar S.: No anomalies for last 90m, will keep monitoring until prod promote. :thumbsup:
Leah P.: Closing notes: deliverables for this thread -> autoscaler prod promote (Sam), runtime hotfix merge (Mike), sec approval (Tanya), model smoke tests (Jia). Reopen thread if any ETA slips. Thanks everyone!
